name: Ryina no Money Quest ~Okane Kasegi wa Ecchi ga Ippai~
original_name: リィナのマネークエスト ～お金稼ぎはエッチがいっぱい～
source:
Ryina needed money to buy a magical potion,
so she did what people do: got a job.

But would she choose part-time labor, monster quests,
or special remuneration for sexual deeds......

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ155522.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
瑞娜需要钱去购买魔法药剂，
所以她做了人们都会做的事：找到一份工作。

但她会选择打工、怪物任务、
或性行为的特殊报酬……
